title: Flexible Imputation of Incomplete Network Data
abstract: arXiv:2604.03171v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Sampled network data are widely used in empirical research because collecting complete network information is costly. However, empirical analyses based on sampled networks may lead to biased estimators. We propose a nonparametric imputation method for sampled networks and show that empirical analyses based on imputed networks yield consistent estimates. Our approach imputes missing network links by combining a projection onto covariates with a local two-way fixed-effects regression. The method avoids parametric assumptions, does not rely on low-rank restrictions, and flexibly accommodates both observed covariates and unobserved heterogeneity. We establish entrywise convergence rates for the imputed matrix and prove the consistency of generalized method of moments (GMM) estimators based on imputed networks. We further derive the convergence rate of the corresponding estimator in the linear-in-means peer-effects model. Simulations show

translated_title: 不完整网络数据的灵活插补方法
translated_abstract: 由于收集完整的网络信息成本高昂，抽样网络数据在实证研究中被广泛使用。然而，基于抽样网络的实证分析可能导致有偏的估计量。我们提出了一种针对抽样网络的非参数插补方法，并证明基于插补网络的实证分析能够产生一致的估计。我们的方法通过将协变量投影与局部双向固定效应回归相结合来插补缺失的网络链接。该方法避免了参数假设，不依赖低秩约束，并能灵活地容纳可观测协变量和不可观测的异质性。我们建立了插补矩阵的逐元素收敛速度，并证明了基于插补网络的广义矩估计（GMM）的一致性。我们进一步推导了线性均值同伴效应模型中相应估计量的收敛速度。模拟结果表明……
tldr: 本文提出一种针对抽样网络的非参数插补方法，通过协变量投影与局部双向固定效应回归相结合来插补缺失网络链接，并证明基于插补网络的GMM估计具有一致性。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a nonparametric imputation method for sampled networks that combines covariate projection with local two-way fixed-effects regression, and proves the consistency of GMM estimators based on imputed networks.
